topic: How an AI agent decides which tool to use
title: How does an AI agent pick a tool?
disclosure: Illustrations are AI-generated concept art, not product screenshots.
caption:
An AI agent reads your request, checks its list of tools, and picks the one that fits. Save this for the next time an agent surprises you.

Follow @_brewiq.

beats.voice: Ask an AI agent to do something, and it has to choose a tool first.
beats.lower_third: An agent has to choose a tool first.

on_screen.headline: How does an AI agent pick a tool?

shot.subject: scene
shot.prompt: A friendly workbench seen from the front with a calendar, a search lens, a calculator and a small envelope laid out as tools, warm light, one glowing cyan highlight on the lens.

beats.voice: It reads your request and matches it against what each tool says it can do.
beats.lower_third: It matches your request to tool descriptions.

beats.voice: Ask about next week, and it reaches for the calendar. Ask for a fact, and it searches.

on_screen.card: Next week? Calendar. A fact? Search.

beats.voice: So write your request clearly, and tell it which tool you expect it to use.
beats.lower_third: Name the tool you expect it to use.
